item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:45 HKT 06/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be windier with one or two rain patches over the region. The monsoon is expected to moderate on Friday. Another intense northeast monsoon will reach southern China during the weekend. Temperatures will fall progressively over the region next week.

Date/Month: 07/11 (Tuesday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Becoming cloudy. Bright periods during the day. One or two light rain patches at night.
Temp range: 23 - 27 C
R.H. range: 65 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
